source_scope: Packaged original JPEGs versus crop cache from latest fixed HYPIR fresh-full PNG; original JPEGs are visual references, not fresh scored baseline. No ground truth or cross-model RNG equivalence claim.

observed_fixed_ROIs.case7: Original packaged output: swollen letter strokes and many repeated small ripples/crevices in red background. Teacher has more continuous, legible glyph boundaries and flatter sign surface.
observed_fixed_ROIs.case16: Original packaged output: horizontal grill bars merge and bend; handle region is thickened, and repeated dark holes/bright edges replace small connections. Teacher keeps many thin separated bars and a clearly bounded handle.
observed_fixed_ROIs.case41: Original packaged output: background leaves are blurred, petal boundary has a dark/bright halo and the petal carries dense skin-like repeated texture. Teacher preserves distinguishable stems/leaves and gentler petal tone transitions.
observed_fixed_ROIs.case83: Original packaged output: leaves and rose edges have bright overshoot, small black pits and repetitive wrinkle texture. Teacher shows cleaner leaf boundaries and more continuous petal folds.

limitations: Fine JPEG texture/compression effects cannot be assigned wholly to the model; repeat check on fresh original PNG103.
Teacher is a pseudo target, not ground truth; copying its sharpening, invented details or color errors is a fidelity risk.
Four fixed cases do not establish complete dataset quality or score.

loss_proposal.normalization: Pixel L1 and first-difference L1 are means on RGB [0,1]. LPIPS gets RGB [-1,1]. Horizontal/vertical first-difference means are averaged. Targets are fixed teacher native PNGs, geometrically paired to actual input by case and crop.
same_controls: Same original PixG5i initialization, optimizer recipe, LR, RNG/sample sequence, update count and checkpoints between losses.
Use only test100 input/teacher pseudo-target pairs for fitting; validation GT is not training data.
Preserve original checkpoint cfg/state format and original Runner deployment folding/FP16; actual step0 deployment check should detect format or output-range errors.
No teacher JPEG targets. No reward that directly maximizes sharpness/gradient magnitude.

crop_context_suggestion.reason: Actual package cfg uses no normalization, ps2, 3 levels and finite local convolutions. Native context reduces boundary/phase mismatch; confirm central crop equivalence on real data rather than claiming full-NN exactness from a receptive-field estimate.

selection_observations: Glyph stroke count/connectivity and sign borders; do not accept high NR that breaks characters.
Grill bar count and separation, handle/joint screw placement and dark mark topology.
Petal fold and stem/leaf boundary positions, halos, cellular repeated texture and local smoothing.
Report each formal NR component and FR separately; if artifacts improve while S drops, report that tradeoff honestly.
